notes: Private or sensitive raw data must not be committed to the repository.
The Yemeni tax-revenue dataset is referenced as a local authorized legacy case only.
Synthetic datasets are generated by code and do not require raw data files.
Public datasets can be added later under data/public/ only if redistribution is allowed.

datasets.name: yemen_tax_revenue
datasets.description: Authorized local Yemeni tax-revenue series used as a legacy motivating/replication case. Raw values are not included in the public repository.

datasets.name: synthetic_linear_ar
datasets.description: Controlled linear autoregressive process for checking whether simple baselines remain competitive.

datasets.name: synthetic_nonlinear_sine
datasets.description: Nonlinear smooth process for testing nonlinear modeling benefit and sensitivity control.

datasets.name: synthetic_regime_switching
datasets.description: Piecewise process with regime changes for testing robustness and failure modes.

datasets.name: synthetic_spiky_outbreak
datasets.description: Outbreak-like process with abrupt spikes for testing boundedness and extrapolation behavior.

datasets.name: synthetic_noisy_seasonal
datasets.description: Seasonal process for comparing against seasonal naive, ETS, Theta, and ARIMA.
